schema.title: Response Viewed As Api Account Viewed As Get

get.description:
What merging whoever has the handle `merge` into whoever has `keep` would do,
for the custodian to confirm.

post.description:
Merge one account into the other and close it. Only the custodian can, and only
with a reason. It can't be undone.

get.description:
For the custodian: every event in the log, in every troupe and outside them,
that the filters find, newest first, a page at a time. `q` is words that must all
be in the event as it reads.

For the custodian: characters to search the log by, whosever and wherever they
are, retired ones too: up to 20 with `q` in their name, or just `character_id`.

schema.title: Response Characters Api Audit Characters Get

get.description:
For the custodian: everything the same filters find, newest first, as a CSV.
The export itself goes in the log.
For the custodian: the groups of actions and the troupes to search by.
Whose email a link changes, and to what, so the page can ask first.

post.description:
Confirm a change from the link sent to the new address: the email changes,
and the old address is told.

get.description: Whether someone who forgot their password can ask Horatio for a link.

post.description:
Email a reset link to an account's own address, if an account uses it. The
answer is the same either way, so it never says who has an account; so is
being turned away for asking too often.

Set a new password from a reset link. Ends every other session the person had,
and signs them in here.

get.description: Whose password a reset link sets, so the page can say.

The backup's file. It holds everything, password hashes included, so each
download is logged.

schema.title: Response My Characters Api Characters Get

post.description:
Players build characters on their own, outside any troupe: of any splat with
no building troupe, else of a splat it takes.

delete.description:
Delete a character for good. It must be in no troupe: leaving each one first
is what tells those troupes' storytellers.

patch.description:
Rename the character: its player, at most once every three months while it is
in a troupe, or the custodian at any time (see horatio/renames.py).

get.description:
One character's badge, with its titles in `troupe_id` (by default its home
troupe, else the first troupe it joined).

put.description:
Build by a troupe's rules (or, with none, the plain rule set) until a home
troupe accepts the character; then that troupe's rules apply.

post.description:
Make a list of sheet changes in one transaction, each priced as if the
earlier ones had been made, and the sheet they end with checked against the
one they started from. If any is refused, none is made, and each line says
what it costs or why it is refused. A dry run says the same, saving nothing.

put.description: Replace every creation pick in one category at once: one step of the wizard.

get.description: The diablerie on the sheet. Who was diablerized shows to staff only.

post.description:
A storyteller or assistant storyteller of the character's home troupe records a
diablerie: Generation up one, free, and the rest of what p. 306 changes. The player
is told.

delete.description: The player takes back the diablerie they asked to record.

post.description:
The player says their character committed diablerie. It waits on the home
troupe's storytellers; approving it does what recording one does.

get.description:
What recording a diablerie would do to the sheet, for staff to see before they
confirm: the Generation, the techniques lost, the Humanity or Beast traits it fills
in, and what the troupe's setting does to a Lesser Generation or Thin Blooded flaw.

delete.description:
Take back discipline dots still waiting on the home troupe, or a merit or flaw
request, and get the XP back.

get.description: A ghoul's domitor; None while it has none, and for a vampire.

schema.title: Response Read Domitor Api Characters  Character Id  Domitor Get

put.description:
Bind a ghoul to its domitor (MET: VTM pp. 296–297): its player, until a home
troupe accepts it; after that, the home troupe's running staff, once the old bond
has faded.

schema.title: Response Change Domitor Api Characters  Character Id  Domitor Put

get.description:
The vampires, PCs and NPCs, that the ghoul's player can see and bind it to,
whose names hold `q`: the first 20 by name.

get.description:
The player's own character's entries that a discovery block in this cycle
can hide. Players never see anyone else's.
Delivered downtime results for the player's character, newest first.

get.description:
The character's Embrace, once it has been Embraced, and whether this viewer can
run one now.

post.description:
The ghoul becomes a vampire of its sire's clan, all its steps at once or none
(MET: VTM pp. 297–299). Its player is told.
The ghoul died in the attempted Embrace: it is retired, with a note in its log.

What the Embrace would do with these choices, step by step with its XP, for
staff to see before they confirm. Nothing is saved.

get.description:
The vampires in Horatio the staff member can see, by name, that could be the
sire: with their clan, and generation as their sheets have it.

get.description:
What the character holds, for whoever sees its sheet; the staff note only for
its home troupe's staff.

Discard the item, by the holder's player or its home troupe's staff. It is
kept, with its history, for staff to restore.

Give the item to another character of the holder's home troupe, at once: by
the holder's player, to the troupe's PCs and the NPCs holding a title there, or
by its staff, to any home character. One for a character of another home troupe
is refused.

get.description: What a merit would let the player choose if the character took it now.

A storyteller or assistant storyteller of a player's character's home troupe
gives it a trait, or raises one: free, despite the rules, or both, always with
a reason. Nothing waits on approval; the player is told.

get.description:
The names of the locations the character controls, and what their qualities
give it: for its player, without why one is off; for staff, with it.

post.description: The differences the player must settle to make `troupe_id` the home troupe.

(or, while it is being built, the troupe it is built for), not archived.

flaws: free or charged, and with a reason for the logs. Never to a character
only visiting the troupe.

Running staff of the troupe take one of its house merits or flaws off the
character, with a reason.

Say which sect or group has Accepted each identity. The player and the
staff of its home troupe can.

get.description:
The character's own influence actions, newest first, from every troupe it
has acted in. Never another character's, nor blocks others placed.

Ask to acquire, add a quality to, undermine or repair a location, or to learn
whose locations are whose. Counts toward the troupe's requests per cycle.

Everything that happened to the character, newest first. Its player sees it
all; a troupe's staff see the sheet's own history and what happened in their
troupe, not in the character's other troupes.

to confirm.

Give the character to whoever has the handle. Only the custodian can, and
only with a reason.

Turn a Stock NPC into a sheeted one, its sheet starting from its rating and
specializations (horatio.npcs.make_sheeted). There is no turning back.

For each category, the traits a merit opens past a check for the character,
and why they cost what they do ("Hard as Steel: 20 XP"), with the sheet as the
cart's changes would leave it. Nothing is saved.

portrait is the biggest square in the middle.

One of the picture's files. A picture's files never change (a new one has a
new id), so browsers may keep them; privately, as only some people see them.
The character's trackers and limited uses at the game now, and its log.
